description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
May I ask one more question about your stand on “can a woman give a sermon on Sabbath day?
.
Why did Lot want to send his two virgin daughters to be gang-r***d instead of the two strangers? Gen 19:8
.
I'd like to know when do we interpret a text as literal or spiritual? 
A friend insists that Sabbath now is spiritual, not literal, interpreting Matthew 11:28-30 and Hebrews 4:9. Another reason he believes that Sabbath is not literal is that we don't have a universal sabbath because of time differences. Please help clarify these texts.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org!
